source: Compiled from Microsoft Learn / DAX Guide function name list (names only).

entries.name: ADDCOLUMNS
entries.example_sql: SELECT t.*, (t.Amount * 2) AS Amount2 FROM Sales AS t

entries.name: CONCATENATEX
entries.example_sql: (SELECT LENGTH(STRING_AGG(Region, ',' ORDER BY Region)) FROM Sales)

entries.name: CROSSJOIN
entries.sql_template: (SELECT * FROM ({{t1}}) AS t1 CROSS JOIN ({{t2}}) AS t2)
entries.example_sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Sales.CustomerKey FROM Sales) AS t1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Returns.CustomerKey FROM Returns) AS t2

entries.name: DIVIDE
entries.sql_template: CASE WHEN {{denominator}} IS NULL OR {{denominator}} = 0 THEN {{alternate_result}} ELSE ({{numerator}} / {{denominator}}) END
entries.example_sql: CASE WHEN 2 IS NULL OR 2 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (10 / 2) END

entries.name: EXCEPT
entries.example_sql: (SELECT DISTINCT Sales.CustomerKey FROM Sales) EXCEPT (SELECT DISTINCT Returns.CustomerKey FROM Returns)

entries.name: HASH
entries.example_sql: CASE WHEN HASH(1) = HASH(1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entries.name: INDEX
entries.example_sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Amount) AS idx FROM Sales

entries.name: INTERSECT
entries.example_sql: (SELECT DISTINCT Sales.CustomerKey FROM Sales) INTERSECT (SELECT DISTINCT Returns.CustomerKey FROM Returns)

entries.name: NAMEOF
entries.example_sql: CASE WHEN LENGTH(DAX_NAMEOF(1)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entries.name: NOW
entries.example_sql: CASE WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP > DATE '2020-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entries.name: OFFSET
entries.example_sql: SELECT LAG(Amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY Amount) AS prev FROM Sales

entries.name: RANKX
entries.example_sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Amount) AS r FROM Sales

entries.name: ROUNDDOWN
entries.sql_template: (CASE WHEN {{number}} >= 0 THEN FLOOR({{number}} * POW(10, {{num_digits}})) / POW(10, {{num_digits}}) ELSE CEIL({{number}} * POW(10, {{num_digits}})) / POW(10, {{num_digits}}) END)
entries.example_sql: (CASE WHEN 12.34 >= 0 THEN FLOOR(12.34 * POW(10, 1)) / POW(10, 1) ELSE CEIL(12.34 * POW(10, 1)) / POW(10, 1) END)

entries.name: ROUNDUP
entries.sql_template: (CASE WHEN {{number}} >= 0 THEN CEIL({{number}} * POW(10, {{num_digits}})) / POW(10, {{num_digits}}) ELSE FLOOR({{number}} * POW(10, {{num_digits}})) / POW(10, {{num_digits}}) END)
entries.example_sql: (CASE WHEN 12.34 >= 0 THEN CEIL(12.34 * POW(10, 1)) / POW(10, 1) ELSE FLOOR(12.34 * POW(10, 1)) / POW(10, 1) END)

entries.name: SELECTCOLUMNS
entries.example_sql: SELECT Sales.Amount AS Amount FROM Sales

entries.name: SUMMARIZECOLUMNS
entries.example_sql: SELECT Category, SUM(Amount) AS TotalAmount FROM Sales GROUP BY Category

entries.name: TOPN
entries.example_sql: SELECT * FROM Sales ORDER BY Sales.Amount DESC LIMIT 5

entries.name: UNION
entries.example_sql: (SELECT DISTINCT Sales.CustomerKey FROM Sales) UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT Returns.CustomerKey FROM Returns)

entries.name: USERNAME
entries.example_sql: CASE WHEN LENGTH(DAX_USERNAME()) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entries.name: USEROBJECTID
entries.example_sql: CASE WHEN LENGTH(DAX_USEROBJECTID()) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entries.name: USERPRINCIPALNAME
entries.example_sql: CASE WHEN LENGTH(DAX_USERPRINCIPALNAME()) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entries.name: UTCNOW
entries.example_sql: CASE WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP > DATE '2020-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entries.name: WINDOW
entries.example_sql: SELECT DAX_WINDOW(1) OVER (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY 1)

entries.name: XNPV
entries.example_dax: XNPV(0.05, DATATABLE("Value", DOUBLE, "Date", DATETIME, {{-100, DATE(2024,1,1)}, {110, DATE(2025,1,1)}}), [Value], [Date])
